title: Trapped pieces
line: A piece with no safe square, usually a bishop or a knight on the edge.

steps.text: White's bishop has taken a pawn in the corner. It looks safe, but its only ways out are b8 and b6.
First trade rooks, so White's rook cannot come to the bishop's help.
Now shut the bishop in: push a pawn one square, so the bishop has no safe square left.
steps.after: Your king guards b8, and the bishop cannot get out.

steps.text: Walk your king toward the bishop.
steps.after: Next, the king captures the bishop.

summary: A piece that grabs a pawn on the edge can find every way out shut. Close the last door and collect it.
